objective: Bring 4 Gromsblood, 10 Giant Silver Veins and Nagmara's Filled Vial to Mistress Nagmara in Blackrock Depths.

description: Oh, the pains of love!  My dear Private Rocknot is immune to my charms.  I am spurned!  It's maddening!

You must help me!  We succubi know much of love, and I can make a potion to beat down the iron walls around Rocknot's heart.  To make it, I need these items: the herb gromsblood, giant silver veins from the cliff giants of Azshara, and water from the Golakka Springs Crater in Un'Goro.  You can place the water in this vial.
Please, <name>, help a poor soul in her quest for happiness!
progress: Do you have the ingredients?  The hole in my heart threatens to consume me!
completion: Oh, you've done it!  I can now make my potion and use it on Rocknot.  Finally, he will fall victim to my charms!
Thank you, <name>.  You are a champion of love!

note: Gromsblood, Giant Silver Veins (Azshara cliff giants) and the vial filled at Golakka Hot Springs in Un'Goro. Opens a peaceful way through the bar on later visits.
